selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms of right foot drop, numbness, and pain in the lateral leg, along with the findings of decreased muscle strength in the tibialis anterior and extensor hallucis longus, are consistent with peroneal neuropathy. The absence of significant nerve-root compression on MRI and the failure to elicit an evoked myogenic potential on repeat peroneal conduction studies also support this diagnosis.
